newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RTRS-BT Australia names investment bank chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BT Australia names investment bank chief.

text.p: Bankers Trust Australia Ltd on Wednesday named BT New Zealand Chief Executive Gavin Walker as head of Bankers Trust Investment Bank, based in Sydney.
Walker will retain his New Zealand responsibilities until his replacement as chief executive is chosen, and this is expected before the end of the year.
Walker, in his new role, will take overall responsibility for all Investment Bank activity including the existing corporate finance, financial markets and equities groups.
Integrating those three business lines is designed to deliver better customer service by pooling the resources of BT Australia Ltd and avoiding overlaps, the bank said.
Walker, 44, will aassume the new appointment immediately and report to Bankers Trust Australia Managing Director Rob Ferguson.
